value.title: 134 — omp/pi take the extension stream with no composer veto; senders are told when a row is still queued or landed late
value.summary: Route Omp/Pi directly to the queue-backed extension event stream before composer gates; notify senders when queued or delivered late.

sections.name: summary
sections.value: req-0054 (magpie 2026-09-02, msg 888D45C1): a ruling to a working omp returned `queued, reason:human-typing` and delivered on attempt 101, eight minutes late. Omp/Pi must bypass both composer gates and `select_rung`, entering the queue-backed Observe/message.pushed path immediately; the extension claims and acknowledges the row after injecting it at turn end. Correction 2026-09-02: the production `Transport` is Claude-only `UdsTransport`; the Omp/Pi extension stream is the event bus plus inbox claim, not a Transport. A second unit adds sender-visible still-queued and delivered-late notices.

sections.name: goals
value: A message to a working omp/pi seat is handed to the extension stream immediately; no composer capture or human-typing veto for those harnesses.

A row still queued after N seconds (config, default 60) raises a pushed notice to the sender naming msg_id, recipient, reason, and attempts; later delivery raises delivered late, and the sender's next pij-rs command prints outstanding notices on stderr.

sections.name: non_goals
value: Changing the veto for Claude/Copilot/Codex panes, where a human composer can exist.
Any OMP extension change beyond what the stream already does.
Restarting the production rs daemon or running any flowspace3 daemon.

value.text: LIVE, dev daemon: hand-started omp in tmux, mid-turn (give it a long task); `pij-rs send` returns delivered (or queued with a reason that is NOT human-typing) and the turn arrives at the end of the current turn — transcript + timestamps pasted; CONTROL on main first: same gesture returns queued/human-typing (pasted).
